scope: Actual Vortex with isolated user data, owned executable copy and test profiles. The game was not launched; native game acceptance remains separately recorded.

checks.callback: Vortex reports completion; failure confirmed by error dialog and file readback

checks.ack: confirmed by file and idle-state readback

notes: No existing MT2 extension was found in the official catalog or bundled game support on the research date. The separate MT2 Mod Manager uses a different manifest contract.
Vortex 2.8.2 notification events swallow handler rejection. Guards run in awaited deployment methods, including external-change detection before Vortex can apply its conflict choices.
Vortex can complete its deploy callback while presenting a deployment failure. Acceptance checks visible causes, file bytes and full inventories rather than callback success alone.
The original failing event-hook candidate and timeout/conflict-dialog receipts were retained locally. Completed effects were checked before any continuation.
A supported executable is required for deployment. Game management and removal remain available after an update.
The final transition slice changes the earlier strict purge handling to preserve a recoverable manual configuration; the unaffected install/profile slice is retained rather than repeated.
limits: Human newcomer timing and multiplayer bridge acceptance remain pending.
No Nexus upload or automatic extension catalog listing has been performed.
No original user Vortex settings or real game installation were modified.
